$comment: §31. The existing construct evaluated through the same matrix, so the comparison is not rigged by exempting the incumbent.

product_relevance.what_product_question_it_informs: Public exposure of a remote-access protocol across a defined address population, as a technology-exposure and deployment-footprint signal.
product_relevance.weakest_truthful_interpretation: A count of addresses whose peer emitted an SSH-prefixed identification string. It is not a count of organisations, users, customers, installations or purchases.

proposition.observation_window_semantics: the time at which the probe that generated the response occurred, selectable before retrieval
proposition.predicate: TCP port 22 accepted a connection AND, before protocol negotiation, the peer emitted an identification string beginning with the literal prefix SSH-
proposition.inclusion_rule: an address is counted once if at least one qualifying observation falls inside W
proposition.exclusion_rule: addresses with no qualifying observation inside W are not counted; an address excluded from scanning is outside the frame rather than a zero
proposition.vantage_semantics: unspecified across apparatuses; a difference in scanner vantage can change reachability and is not absorbed into reliability
proposition.configuration_assumptions: TCP/22 must be inside the scanned port set for the window, for every apparatus counted

what_a_positive_observation_establishes: That at that moment, from that vantage, that address accepted a TCP connection on port 22 and sent bytes beginning SSH-.
explicit_non_claims: not the number of SSH servers on the Internet
not the number of organisations running SSH
not adoption, market share or installations
not that the service is reachable from anywhere else

Censys.note: The only Censys surface whose temporal object is right is the dated Universal Internet Dataset snapshot, and whether it carries a raw banner is not documented outside the authenticated console. The Platform surface carries a banner and a LAST-observed timestamp.

A8 stays PARTIAL, which makes this a route requiring deep qualification rather than an implausible one.

ONYPHE.note: B2 PARTIAL and B4 PARTIAL, both global rather than construct-specific. The sent enquiry is outstanding and improves no gate.

Rapid7 Project Sonar.note: The arbitrary-TCP-port resource publishes SYN responses and no response bytes; the HTTP resource is not port 22.
